The '''Midnight Squid''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the submarine ride at the [[Night Market]], which takes place at [[The Beach]] during [[Winter]] 15-17.

In the submarine ride at the Night Market, there is a 21% chance to hook a Midnight Squid (17% if using a [[Curiosity Lure]]). If using Magic Bait in the southwest corner of the beach, there is a 3.3% chance to hook a Midnight Squid (10.2% if using a Curiosity Lure).<ref name="requirements"/>

When placed in a [[Fish Pond]], Midnight Squid will produce [[Squid Ink]] instead of [[Roe]]. However, Midnight Squid Roe can be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after obtaining the power from the [[Jewels Of The Sea]] book.

Midnight Squid can also be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]] — cast west from the left-most pier in the southwest corner of the beach.

==Tailoring==
Midnight Squid can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Fishing Hat|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Midnight Squid can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 3 days.  The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests.  Instead of producing [[Roe]], squid ponds produce [[Squid Ink]].
